documented_probe: Documented probe waiver: C-857c8f99 ((mixed-)integer programming with equality-sum constraints) has a hard reference floor; the v2 covering task exercises it at medium difficulty with hidden instances and exact-optimum checks. Harder MIP instances are covered by other optimization tasks in the suite.
notes: Core is a lexicographic (return, risk, count) integer allocation problem over a two-resource (budget, risk) knapsack. Difficulty sits in generalizing to arbitrary catalogs: hidden cases probe zero-cost/zero-risk resource-bound correctness, infeasible catalogs, empty catalogs, and exact tie-breaking on the third objective, all requiring the solver (deliverable /app/solve.py) to be run on unseen inputs and compared to an independently re-derived optimum.
